note: Two more projectiles, quicker, at the cost of less damage.

def.name: Triple Shot
def.description: Two more projectiles, a little faster, each hitting less hard.

note: Attacks gain life for each enemy hit.

def.name: Blood Refund
def.description: Attacks restore life for each enemy they hit.

note: Every third use of the melee attack is a Ruthless Blow: much more melee damage, much more bleed damage, and a stun.

def.name: Merciless Cadence
def.description: Every third melee blow lands with great force and stuns.

note: Channelling skills deal more damage; while channelling you take less damage from hits, and after channelling for a while you are Infused: more damage, lasting six seconds after you stop.

def.name: Charged Breath
def.description: Channelled skills hit harder, guard you while they last and leave you infused.
